title: Write and Solve Equations Using Addition or Subtraction

items.stem: Which of the following equations can be solved using subtraction to find the value of x?
Sarah had some pencils. After giving 8 pencils to her friend, she has 15 pencils left. Which equation represents this situation?
Select ALL the true statements about solving the equation x + 6 = 14 by subtraction.
choices: You subtract 6 from both sides to isolate x.
Subtracting 6 will give the value of x.
You add 6 to both sides to solve the equation.

items.stem: Write and solve an equation for the following problem. Show or explain your work: A number decreased by 9 equals 20. What is the number?
